title: Glycoside combinations of Buyang Huanwu decoction ameliorate atherosclerosis via STAT3, HIF-1, and VEGF.
authors: Yan, Fanchen; Ding, Huang; Sun, Zhengji; Liu, Jingze; Li, Junxi; Zhou, Dan; Zhang, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究补阳还五汤糖苷组合通过STAT3/HIF-1/VEGF改善动脉粥样硬化，虽含分子对接但核心为细胞实验与网络药理学，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Buyang Huanwu decoction (BYHWD) is a classical traditional prescription. Glycosides are effective extracts of BYHWD, which have been proven to protect blood vessels and prevent atherosclerosis (AS). However, the mechanism of glycosides in inhibiting abnormal angiogenesis in atherosclerosis is still unclear. The specific amygdalin (AG), paeoniflorin (PF), and astragaloside IV (ASV) contents in the BYHWD-containing serum were detected using mass spectrometry. Network pharmacology and molecular docking are used to screen the targets of glycosides for treating atherosclerosis. The predicted targets were validated in an AS model of rat thoracic aortic endothelial cells (RTAEC) induced by oxidized low-density lipoprotein (ox-LDL). According to the mass spectrometry data, the specific contents of AG, PF, and ASV in the serum were 24.11 ng/ml, 20.94 ng/ml, and 69.87 ng/ml, respectively. Results of bioinformatics analysis show that signal transducer and activator of transcription (STAT)-3, hypoxia-inducible factor (HIF)-1, and vascular endothelial-derived growth factor (VEGF) may be involved in the treatment of AS with glycosides. The results of cell experiments revealed that glycoside combinations could treat atherosclerosis by inhibiting STAT3, HIF-1, and VEGF. AG, PF, and ASV are the effective ingredients of BYHWD. Glycoside combinations significantly ameliorate atherosclerosis by inhibiting STAT3, HIF-1, and VEGF.
abstract_zh: 补阳还五汤（BYHWD）是一种经典的传统方剂。糖苷是BYHWD的有效提取物，已被证明能够保护血管并预防动脉粥样硬化（AS）。然而，糖苷在抑制动脉粥样硬化中异常血管生成的作用机制仍不清楚。采用质谱法检测了含BYHWD血清中特定苦杏仁苷（AG）、芍药苷（PF）和黄芪甲苷IV（ASV）的含量。通过网络药理学和分子对接筛选糖苷治疗动脉粥样硬化的靶点。预测的靶点在氧化低密度脂蛋白（ox-LDL）诱导的大鼠胸主动脉内皮细胞（RTAEC）AS模型中进行了验证。质谱数据显示，血清中AG、PF和ASV的特定含量分别为24.11 ng/ml、20.94 ng/ml和69.87 ng/ml。生物信息学分析结果表明，信号转导与转录激活因子（STAT）-3、缺氧诱导因子（HIF）-1和血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）可能参与糖苷治疗AS的过程。细胞实验结果显示，糖苷组合可通过抑制STAT3、HIF-1和VEGF来治疗动脉粥样硬化。AG、PF和ASV是BYHWD的有效成分。糖苷组合通过抑制STAT3、HIF-1和VEGF显著改善动脉粥样硬化。
